# Volumetric Photon Mapping with Radiance Transfer
## Overview
Volumetric Photon Mapping with Radiance Transfer is a rendering technique that integrates [volumetric photon mapping](#2190-volumetric-photon-mapping.md) into a pre-designed radiance transfer procedure to achieve real-time, realistic volume rendering [S1]. It separates direct and indirect lighting computations and allows effective updates to the photon map when transfer functions change [S1].
## How it works
**Inputs:** Not given in the sources. [S1]
**Outputs:** Not given in the sources. [S1]
**Data Structures:** A data format for assessing scene areas affected by altering the transfer function to allow effective updates to the photon map [S1]. Standard photon map structures are not detailed in the sources. [S1]
**Steps:**
1. Render direct and indirect lighting separately using a raycaster [S1].
2. Incorporate the volumetric photon mapping algorithm into the customary predesigned radiance transfer procedure [S1].
3. Assess scene areas affected by transfer function alterations to enable effective photon map updates [S1].
**Formulas:** Not given in the sources. [S1]
**Parameters:** Not given in the sources. [S1]
**Edge Cases and Pitfalls:** Not given in the sources. [S1]
## Subtopics

### [Photon Mapping for RRTE](16476-photon-mapping-for-rrte.md)
A two-pass rendering algorithm for the [Refractive Radiative Transfer Equation](#15236-refractive-radiative-transfer-equation.md) that computes curved photon and ray trajectories analytically or numerically to model continuous refraction, addressing standard [photon mapping](#14521-photon-mapping.md)'s constant index of refraction assumption. Choose it when rendering participating media with spatially varying refractive indices to produce altered caustic shapes and more accurate reflections.

- **Strengths:** Real-time capability; handles wide intensity ranges [S1].
- **Limitations:** Complexity in updating the photon map when transfer functions change [S1].
- **When to use:** Real-time volume rendering applications where interactive performance is critical [S1].
- **When not to use:** Not given in the sources. [S1]
## Background
Described by Zhang et al. [S1]. It incorporates the volumetric photon mapping algorithm into a customary predesigned radiance transfer procedure [S1]. The workflow builds on Daniel et al.'s creation of a data format for assessing scene areas affected by altering transfer functions [S1].
